namespace.description: Namespace where the VIP is created. This field is immutable after creation.

selector.description: Pod names to be selected by this VIP

subnet.description: Subnet name for the VIP. This field is immutable after creation.

type.description: Type of VIP. This field is immutable after creation.

v4ip.description: Specific IPv4 address to use (optional, will be allocated if not specified)

v6ip.description: Specific IPv6 address to use (optional, will be allocated if not specified)

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest state of the VIP

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another

lastUpdateTime.description: Last time this condition was updated

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about the condition

reason.description: Reason for the condition's last transition

status.description: Status of the condition (True, False, Unknown)

mac.description: MAC address associated with the VIP

selector.description: Pod names selected by this VIP
